items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: They approached McShann, they wanted to hire me to come with Charlie Barnet, you know.

ctx.x: He hid me, you know. I didn't even know about it. They approached McShann, they wanted to hire me to come with Charlie Barnet, you know. And so McShann, when the guy told him, instead of McShann telling me, you know, go ahead, be happy, in the meantime he and John Tumino got together and stuck me off in the corner somewhere.

Anyway, I found out about it after they had left town. But I wouldn't have gone, anyway. But anyway, then we -- McShann began to establish the name -- was (inaudible). He established a beachhead, a big beachhead, in Wichita. So we went down there. you may -- I remember having the urge heard some of the records, you know. McShann in his first thing.
